T: Bring the guitar case. Leave the trouble.
D: A mariachi with a guitar case full of weapons hunts the drug boss who ruined his life.
P: Serve the snacks when the stranger walks into the bar to tell his story.
S: Oven-puffed pork crackling dusted with chili salt and lime zest

Pork rind scored, salted and dried overnight, roasted at 240C until puffed and crackling, broken up and dusted with chilli and lime salt. Score 600g pork rind, salt and dry uncovered overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling. Break up and dust with flaky salt mixed with chilli powder and lime zest.

Flour tortillas filled with Monterey Jack, cheddar and pickled jalapeños, cooked in a dry pan until golden and melted, cut into wedges with salsa verde. Mix 200g grated Monterey Jack, 100g grated cheddar and 3 tbsp chopped pickled jalapenos. Spread over half of each of 4 large flour tortillas and fold over. Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese has melted. Rest 1 minute, cut each into 4 wedges and serve with salsa verde and sour cream.
Smashed avocado with lime, onion, green chili and cilantro, warm corn chips
Avocados smashed with lime, white onion, serrano chilli, coriander and salt, with warm tortilla chips.
M: Chili and achiote marinated pork with pineapple in small tortillas

Pork shoulder marinated overnight in dried chillies, achiote, pineapple and vinegar, roasted at 200C, sliced and crisped in a pan, in small corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and coriander. Blitz 3 soaked dried chillies, 50g achiote, 200g pineapple and 2 tbsp vinegar and marinate 1.2kg sliced pork shoulder overnight. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then slice and crisp in a pan. Serve in 16 small tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.
a home-cooked meal in Carolina's flat

Shredded chicken simmered in a smoky tomato, onion and chipotle sauce, piled on crisp tostadas with refried beans, avocado, crema and pickled onion. Poach 700g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes and shred. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft, add 2 garlic cloves, a 400g can of tomatoes and 2 chopped chipotles in adobo. Simmer 10 minutes, then stir in the chicken. Fry 8 corn tortillas at 180C until crisp. Spread with warm refried beans, top with the tinga, sliced avocado, sour cream and red onion soaked in lime juice.
W: Sponge cake soaked in three milks and topped with whipped cream

Sponge baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pricked and soaked overnight in condensed, evaporated and full cream milk, topped with whipped cream and cinnamon. Whisk 5 eggs with 200g sugar until thick and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Prick all over and pour over 395g condensed milk, 375ml evaporated milk and 125ml milk. Soak overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream and cinnamon.
K: Mezcal, blood orange, lime and agave shaken hard, chili salt rim

Smoky mezcal shaken hard with blood orange juice, fresh lime and agave syrup, poured over ice into glasses rimmed with chilli salt. Mix 2 tbsp salt and 1 tsp chilli powder on a saucer, wet the rims of four glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill a shaker with ice and add 180ml mezcal, 180ml blood orange juice, 90ml lime juice and 60ml agave syrup. Shake hard for 15 seconds, working in two batches if needed. Strain into the glasses over fresh ice and garnish each with an orange wheel.

Smash the avocados with lime juice, then stir in the onion, chilli, coriander and salt.
Serve with warm corn chips.

veg.n: Bucho's tacos al pastor with oyster mushrooms

ingredients.item: fresh pineapple, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with achiote, pineapple and vinegar.
Coat the mushrooms in the marinade.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Spread on an oiled tray, drizzle with the oil and roast at 220C until caramelised at the edges.
Crisp the mushrooms in batches in a hot pan.
Serve in the tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.

Fold in the flour and pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 175C until golden and springy.
Prick the cake all over and pour over the condensed, evaporated and full cream milk.
Soak overnight in the fridge.
Whip the cream, spread over the top and dust with cinnamon.

Wet the rims of four glasses with lime and dip them in the salt.
Juice the blood oranges and limes.
Shake the mezcal, juices and agave hard over ice for 15 seconds, in two batches if needed.
Strain over fresh ice and garnish each glass with an orange wheel.

af.make_ahead: Steep and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead; juice the fruit, salt the rims and shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill the smoky tea.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer.
Wet the rims of four glasses with lime and dip them in the salt.
Juice the blood oranges and limes, keeping back a few orange wheels.
Shake 120ml of the tea, the juices and agave hard over ice for 15 seconds, in two batches if needed.
Strain over fresh ice and garnish each glass with an orange wheel.
